completeOriginalProcedureUnchanged: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP one invisible eye that moves and sees for you. NEW create a nonphysical one-inch-diameter magical sensor in a perceived unoccupied point with originating line of effect; replace Instantaneous with concentration up to one hour. It has no creature identity, HP, weight, inventory, attack, hands, collision, physical support or autonomous intelligence. Its movement is magically sustained in three dimensions and can remain at a fixed open point without physical hover anatomy. Creation supplies no extra move. On a later caster Action move it up to thirty feet along one continuously open path; solid matter blocks its path despite being nonphysical, and a real aperture must be at least one inch across throughout the route. It cannot open doors, carry/touch objects or pass through a keyhole smaller than that. No independent turn, Bonus Action command or companion offensive allowance is created. At all times the sensor must remain on the caster’s same established plane and within five hundred feet. If the caster moves beyond that tether, its feed and commanded movement are suppressed while the clock runs; returning into range restores only present information. A control Action can move it only while the whole path stays within that tether. No continuing originating line-of-effect tether is required, so it can round a real open corner; actual information/remote-sensing wards apply only according to their own source scope, not automatically to every Universal effect as if it were Divination. Sight is ordinary all-direction vision from its current point using real local illumination, distances, cover and visual obscurity. It grants no darkvision, true sight, wall sight, hearing, scent, language translation, automatic secret search or authentication. Your normal local senses continue; your actual Blindness suppresses this remote Sight channel under the existing sensory interface. You may spend a genuine Search Action observing the current feed with an actually applicable perception procedure, but that Action does not also move the eye. The invisible sensor can be perceived only through an actual effect/sense that can reveal that kind of invisible magical sensor; a creature-only sight power does not reveal a noncreature by default. Detecting some magic is not automatic identification or permission to target it. There is no illusion-disbelief check that destroys the real sensor. No physical attack damages it; an actual effect permitted to end/suppress this rank-four ongoing spell can do so when its own targeting prerequisites are met. If its current point becomes solid or a closing barrier intersects it, the sensor ends, rather than shunting through an unseen wall. Suppression supplies no backlog or off-screen autonomous travel; expiry/removal/concentration loss ends the eye. Received visual information can inform decisions but never supplies a new spell origin, another power’s originating line of effect, remote touch or enlarged casting range. No recording object or replay is created.

INFO131-EYE: NEW exact sensor geometry is a closed radius1/24ft sphere (diameter1inch). All swept points must stay in open space; zero-volume boundary contact can fit an exactly1inch aperture, but any positive-volume overlap with solid matter ends an established sensor. A commanded known impossible path is rejected without consuming its Action; a real new obstruction encountered after legal commitment ends at actual contact, without phasing or a refund. Turning must clear the full sphere, not merely the center. All native generating placements remain Universal; no Divination/Scrying tag is added by theme.
NEW local visibility resolution: Detect Magic's native perceived-aura/effect prerequisite is not waived by an otherwise unperceived invisible sensor. It supplies no independent bootstrap identification of this sensor. Actual acquired Wizard Arcane Sight expressly perceives magical auras within60ft and can independently expose this sensor's Universal aura through clear sight; this is a separate2RP/concentration/recharge2 class spell, not ordinary Detect Magic or free identification of name/owner. A later actual class Dispel may select the perceived ongoing effect under its own60ft/3RP/check. Ordinary aura perception does not make the invisible physical noncreature a new creature target or grant remote spell origin. One caster cannot maintain Eye and another concentration spell without an actual paid exception.
